verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's GitHub docs explicitly mention screenshot capture during crawling and full-page scanning via scrolling, supporting whole-page capture. However, there's no specific evidence of selecting/cropping a specific area or selector-based screenshot capability, only full-page/debugging screenshots. Missing for 10: documented API/parameter for selector-scoped or region-specific screenshot capture, independent hands-on confirmation of screenshot quality/output format.
